videos.descEn: A 21-minute tour of five computers wired like one office, 119 automated morning-report jobs, a subscription bill of about 10 million won a month, cutting cost with model routing and departments, and how to start with one machine (summarized from the description and chapters; includes course and membership plugs; figures are his own).
